# Dentoku Dev

## Site description
Dentoku Dev is a software development studio based in Milan, Italy. It builds focused Chrome extensions, Shopify apps, and lightweight productivity software for practical browser, ecommerce, and business workflows.

## Key pages
- Home: https://www.dentokudev.com/
- Overview: https://www.dentokudev.com/overview
- About: https://www.dentokudev.com/about
- Contact and support: https://www.dentokudev.com/contact
- Blog: https://www.dentokudev.com/blog

## Product pages
- EmailMagnet: https://www.dentokudev.com/emailmagnet
  Chrome extension for finding and extracting emails from websites while browsing.
- ClickPilot AI: https://www.dentokudev.com/clickpilot-ai
  Chrome extension for fixing, rewriting, summarizing, translating, and transforming text inside browser fields.
- Volume Control PRO: https://www.dentokudev.com/volume-control-pro
  Chrome extension for boosting tab audio up to 600% and managing browser volume by site.
- Countdown321: https://www.dentokudev.com/countdown321
  Shopify app for countdown timers and time-based storefront urgency messages.
